title: Secret Assistance
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji tucked the letter close to his body, a cold light flickering in his eyes—the Sect Competition was imminent, and he would let the entire Tianqing Sect witness how atrash would slap everyone's face swollen, step by step.

text.content: The dim oil lamp in the Servants' Quarters flickered as Chen Ji sat cross-legged on a worn meditation cushion, the spiritual energy flowing around him like a mud ox sinking into the sea. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly, seemingly sensing some ominous presence watching—making Chen Ji's heart alert. His cultivation was already difficult enough; if someone was secretly observing, his situation would only grow more dangerous. Outside the window, night wind suddenly rose, causing the oil lamp to flicker erratically, and a faint medicinal fragrance drifted into his nostrils. Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, his gaze falling on the pillow beside him—where, without him knowing when, a pill as warm and lustrous as jade had appeared, its surface faintly showing medicinal patterns.

Chen Ji picked up the pill, his fingertips feeling its refreshing warmth. This was already the third time he had found pills beside his pillow. The first was a Qi Gathering Pill, the second two Foundation Building Pills, and tonight—this was actually a high-quality Soul Condensation Pill! This pill was priceless in the outside world, something even elite Inner Disciples could rarely obtain. And someone was secretly sending such pills to atrash like him? This wasn't kindness; it was suspicious. Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly as he stored the pill in his chest, his mind racing— who? Why help him? And why choose such a covert method?

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fluctuated slightly, a low voice coming from the Turtle Shell: 'Young Master, the origin of this pill is unclear; be cautious about taking it. But this old one observes its quality... it should not be malevolent.'

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer; instead, he brought the pill close to his nose to examine it carefully. The medicinal fragrance was clear and lingering, carrying a faint plum blossom scent—this smell, he seemed to recognize. A vague image flashed through his mind, yet he couldn't grasp the key point. He abruptly stood, pushed open the door, and stepped out. The night was as dark as ink; outside the Servants' Quarters was silent, only faint lights glowing in the distant Inner Sect direction. Chen Ji's eyes narrowed as he施展轻身术, silently dashing toward several positions where the pill-giver might have appeared, trying to track the sender's traces.

dialogue.content: In his heart, Chen Ji thought: 'This plum blossom fragrance... where have I smelled it? This is definitely not some casual act of kindness; this is a deliberate clue left behind.'

text.content: Moonlight like water spilled across the Blue Stone Path of Tianqing Sect. Chen Ji searched meticulously around the Servants' Quarters but found not even one suspicious footprint. The other party's methods were clean and neat, leaving no traces whatsoever, clearly a master at covert operations. He crouched down, fingertips brushing the ground—smooth to the touch—someone had used a Dust Clearing Technique to erase all traces. Such meticulous attention to detail was impossible for an ordinary disciple. Chen Ji slowly stood up, his gaze falling on the distant Inner Sect Main Peak direction, deep in thought. For an Inner Sect master to take such pains to care for atrash, there must be some hidden reason behind it.

Just as he was about to turn back, a night breeze passed by, brushing the branches of an old plum tree by the road. Chen Ji's footsteps halted; he suddenly remembered—didn't the robes of female Inner Disciples have plum blossom patterns embroidered on them? His pupils slightly contracted, and a bold conjecture arose in his heart. To infiltrate the Servants' Quarters at night without being detected, such cultivation was at least Inner Sect elite level. And in Tianqing Sect, the number of people with such ability who might care about atrash like him could be counted on one hand. Chen Ji's lips slightly lifted, but his smile was meaningful. Friend or foe—a single test would reveal it.

dialogue.content: Murmuring to himself: 'Since you want to hide, I'll play the hiding game with you. But... benefits delivered to your door—if you don't take them, you're a fool.'

text.content: Chen Ji didn't pursue the investigation further; instead, he turned back to the Servants' Quarters and carefully stored the Soul Condensation Pill. He had already made his plans—this mysterious benefactor had chosen to assist secretly, clearly unwilling to reveal their identity. Rather than startling the snake, he would go with the flow and see what the other party intended to do. Over the next three days, Chen Ji continued his servant duties, endured oppression and mockery, as if nothing had happened. Only every late night, cultivation pills would appear by his pillow punctually, never interrupted, the types precisely compensating for his weaknesses. Chen Ji appeared unmoved on the surface, but his heart grew increasingly certain—this person knew him extremely well, understanding even his cultivation progress in detail.

choice.prompt: Three days later, Chen Ji found an unsigned letter by his pillow, with only four characters on the envelope—'Chen Ji, Private'. How should he respond?

choices.description: Since the letter could be delivered to his pillow, it meant the sender knew the Servants' Quarters well. Chen Ji decided to take the Servants' Quarters as the center and expand outward to investigate the sender's whereabouts.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more clues about the benefactor
choices.risk_hint: Since the other party dared to leave a letter, they must have follow-up plans

text.content: Chen Ji brought the envelope close to the lamp and examined it carefully. The envelope was made of ordinary paper but faintly exuded sandalwood—this wasn't paper used by typical Tianqing Sect disciples. He carefully cut open the seal, unfolded the letter; the handwriting was elegant and dignified, but the brushstrokes were deliberately altered, clearly to avoid recognition. The letter contained only one sentence, yet it made Chen Ji's pupils suddenly contract—'I know the truth about your father's revenge.'

choices.text: Remain stationary, quietly observe the situation
choices.description: Since the other party proactively left clues, they must have subsequent moves. Rather than rashly investigate and alert them, better to quietly wait for the right moment to see the full picture.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve cards, let the other party reveal more intentions
choices.risk_hint: Might fall into the other party's rhythm

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hurry to open the letter; instead, he placed the envelope by his pillow and sat upright in meditation. He was waiting—for the letter sender to reveal more flaws. The night was deep, all was silent. Suddenly, extremely light footsteps passed outside the window; Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes but didn't chase out. A cold smile curved his lips: 'Want to test my reaction? Then I'll give you something to see.' He reached out and opened the envelope; on the letter paper was only one sentence, yet it made his heartbeat suddenly accelerate—'I know the truth about your father's revenge.'

choices.text: Deliberately leak false information to test
choices.description: Chen Ji decided to use this opportunity to reverse-test—enclose a false message in the letter and observe how the other party reacted, thereby judging whether the benefactor was friend or foe.
choices.visible_reward: Judge the benefactor's stance and intentions through feedback
choices.risk_hint: Might backfire and lose the benefactor's trust

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes rolled, and suddenly an idea struck him. He took out paper and brush, imitating the letter's handwriting to write a note: 'Three days later at the Hour of Rat, meet under the old plum tree at the Back Mountain.' He placed the note back in the envelope and left it untouched by the pillow. As expected, the next morning the envelope had disappeared. Chen Jisneered—someone was indeed monitoring. A few days later, he received a second letter: 'The time is not yet ripe, do not act rashly. Your father's revenge is not something you can contend with.' Chen Ji stared at the words 'your father's revenge,' his pupils slightly contracted, killing intent and curiosity intermingling.

dialogue.content: Staring at that sentence on the letter, Chen Ji's fingers slightly trembled: 'Father's revenge... how does he know about my father?'

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself tocalm下来. His father Chen Xuan, when Chen Ji was five years old, had 'died suddenly' in an accident; at that time, he was still young and only remembered that night of flames reaching the sky, screams tearing through the darkness. Afterward, he was brought to Tianqing Sect as a servant disciple, living under thetrash name ever since. Over more than a decade, no one had ever mentioned his father, as if that person had never existed. And now, someone was writing to say they knew the truth about his father's death? Chen Ji turned the letter paper over; on the back was赫然一行小字—'Three months later at the Sect Competition, I will appear. Then, the truth will be clear.'

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying a rare gravity: 'Young Master, this matter... may be related to this old one. The inheritance of the Tianji Record has never been a simple transmission from master to disciple. Your father's death probably involves a wide conspiracy.'

text.content: Chen Ji gripped the letter paper tightly, his knuckles white. He suddenly remembered Mo Xiansheng had said that the Tianji Record's inheritance had a strict selection mechanism; each generation's inheritor was someone 'chosen' by the Tianji Record. And his father Chen Xuan was precisely the previous generation's candidate for inheritance—only in the end, the Tianji Record chose Chen Ji, not Chen Xuan. What secret lay hidden in this? Why would his father 'die suddenly'? And why would someone choose this timing to reveal these things to him? Chen Ji's thoughts were chaotic, yet quickly restored to his usual composure. He folded the letter paper and tucked it close to his body, his gaze falling on the night sky outside the window, something burning deep in his eyes.

choice.prompt: After learning that his father's revenge might be related to the Tianji Record inheritance, Chen Ji needs to decide his next move.

choices.text: Force Mo Xiansheng for the truth
choices.description: Mo Xiansheng clearly knew something; Chen Ji decided not to wait any longer and directly force out the complete truth about his father and the Tianji Record inheritance.
choices.visible_cost: Might create friction with Mo Xiansheng
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key clues to the truth
choices.risk_hint: Every time Mo Xiansheng unseals something there is a cost; pressing too hard might backfire

dialogue.content: His tone suddenly turned cold: 'Mo Xiansheng, I respect you as my father's old acquaintance, but that doesn't mean I will wait forever. If you know something, speak now.'

choices.text: Make a name for oneself in the Sect Competition
choices.description: Since the benefactor said they would appear at the Sect Competition, then Chen Ji would shine brilliantly in the competition, drawing out the snake with a magnificent posture—at that time, the truth would naturally surface.
choices.visible_cost: Need to expose part of his strength in the competition
choices.visible_reward: Draw out the mysterious benefactor while intimidating enemies within the sect
choices.risk_hint: Exposing oneself too early might bring greater danger

text.content: Chen Ji pressed the letter paper against his chest, closing his eyes in deep thought. When he opened them again, his gaze was clear and bright. His lips curved into a faint smile as he murmured: 'The competition, is it... since you all want to see thetrash make a comeback, I'll give you a show.' Three months was enough time for him to fully absorb the Soul Condensation Pill's medicinal power and become more proficient with the Tianji Record. By then, the mysterious benefactor, the truth about his father—he would personally go and take it all.

choices.text: Investigate the truth about his father's death
choices.description: Chen Ji decided to secretly investigate the truth about his father's death back then, searching for clues in the sect's dusty archives.
choices.visible_cost: Might alert the hidden forces behind the scenes
choices.visible_reward: Gain more initiative before the competition
choices.risk_hint: Investigation might trigger certain people's vigilance

text.content: Chen Ji infiltrated the scripture archive at night, relying on the Tianji Record's faint perception of fate lines to search for any mention of his father Chen Xuan among the vast sea of texts. However, what shocked him was that all records about his father had been deliberately erased—his name, his deeds, even archives of disciples from his father's cohort were incomplete. Chen Ji realized that an invisible hand had begun setting up the board more than a decade ago, and he was merely a chess piece in this grand game.

Night wind blew through the hall, causing the oil lamp to flicker unstably. Chen Ji tucked the letter paper close to his body, his gaze passing through the window lattice toward the distant Inner Sect Main Peak. Three months later would be the Sect Competition, when disciples from all peaks would gather, a mixture of鱼龙—exactly the best opportunity. He would amaze everyone in the competition, proving to the entire Tianqing Sect with absolute strength that thetrash title was merely a disguise he used to protect himself. As for the mysterious benefactor... Chen Ji's lips curved meaningfully. He had plenty of patience to slowly play this game with the other party. Moonlight outside the window was like water, spilling across Chen Ji's resolute profile, revealing eyes as deep as an abyss.

dialogue.content: Murmuring to himself: 'Father, what exactly did you leave behind? Why did everyone want to destroy you, yet someone wants to protect me? The waters of Tianqing Sect are deeper than I imagined...'

text.content: He slowly closed his eyes; the Tianji Record glowed faintly in the depths of his consciousness, the fragmented pages seeming to speak of something. Chen Ji suddenly felt a nameless悸动—his connection with the Tianji Record seemed even closer than before. Perhaps it was because of learning about his father's past, or perhaps due to the stimulation of the mysterious letter, the Tianji Record's recognition of him was quietly improving. Mo Xiansheng had said that the more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the fatal backlash of fate. But at this moment, Chen Ji had only one thought: regardless of any backlash, as long as he could investigate the truth and avenge his father, even if it meant opposing heaven itself, what did it matter? His eyes burned with cold flames—that was the flame of revenge, and also the desire to survive.

Just at this moment, a commotion suddenly arose in the distance. Chen Ji's brow slightly furrowed; he cocked his ear to listen—that was shouting from the Inner Sect direction, as if something major had occurred. His figure flashed, silently darting onto the roof; from afar he saw flames blazing toward the Inner Sect Main Peak, with faint screams audible. Chen Ji's pupils contracted, an ominous premonition rising in his heart. That position of the flames... wasn't that precisely the direction of the scripture archive? He had just left there—could it be discovered so quickly? Chen Ji's gaze turned gloomy; his figure blurred and vanished into the night. Whatever had happened, he had to erase all traces before anyone could investigate.

choice.prompt: Flames blazed into the sky; something major seemed to be happening toward the Inner Sect scripture archive. Chen Ji had just returned from investigating clues about his father there. How should he respond?

choices.text: Risk returning to observe the situation
choices.description: Chen Ji decided to risk turning back to see if it was related to him. If it really was directed at him, he needed to grasp the situation first.
choices.visible_reward: Grasp intelligence at the earliest moment
choices.risk_hint: The other party might have set a trap

text.content: Chen Ji silently approached the scripture archive, yet discovered that the source of the flames wasn't the main scripture archive building, but a side hall beside it. His gaze swept across, his pupils contracting sharply—at the side hall entrance, several bodies lay scattered, all of them Tianqing Sect patrol disciples. What made his heart even more chilled was a familiar figure standing beside those bodies—the Fifth Elder's personal disciple, acting furtively while watching the direction of the scripture archive. A cold smile appeared in Chen Ji's heart: what a perfect case of 'the thief crying thief.'

choices.text: Conceal one's aura and observe secretly
choices.description: Rather than rashly approach, hide to the side to observe the development of events, judging whether this was an accident or a trap aimed at him.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve oneself, clearly see the situation

text.content: Chen Ji收敛全身气息, hiding within the shadows. He saw the Fifth Elder's personal disciple commanding several men to drag the bodies into the side hall, ordering a news blackout. What surprised him even more was that the man actually whispered instructions: 'This matter absolutely cannot let the Sect Master know; say there was an external enemy invasion... have you found any traces of thattrash Chen Ji?' Chen Ji's eyes turned cold—indeed, it was directed at him. But he remained stationary, watching coldly, silently memorizing all of this. Fifth Elder... you want to deal with me? I'll let you have your moment of triumph first.

choices.text: Use the chaos to destroy one's traces
choices.description: While everyone's attention was drawn by the flames, Chen Ji decided to quietly sneak back to the scripture archive to destroy all traces he left behind.
choices.risk_hint: Time is tight, low error tolerance

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate; while everyone's attention was drawn by the flames, his figure like a ghost glided into the scripture archive. He quickly cleared all traces of his browsing, using the Dust Clearing Technique to erase all fingerprints. His movements were fluid, accomplished in merely the time it takes to brew a cup of tea. However, just as he was preparing to leave, an unexpected discovery made his pupils contract sharply—in the depths of the scripture archive was a hidden compartment containing an envelope of the exact same material as the mysterious letter in his chest, with two characters written on it: 'Chen Ji.'

dialogue.content: In his heart, Chen Ji was惊疑不定: 'A second letter... hidden here, is it coincidence or did someone deliberately leave it? Who exactly is this benefactor?'

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the second letter close to his body, not opening it immediately. He took a deep breath, silently withdrawing from the scripture archive, vanishing into the vast night. After returning to the Servants' Quarters, he took out the letter. The two characters 'Chen Ji' on the envelope had vigorous brushwork, identical to the previous letter—definitely written by the same person. Chen Ji opened the envelope, unfolded the letter paper; there were only a few brief lines: 'Your father Chen Xuan was the Seventeenth Generation Inheritor of the Tianji Record. He did not die suddenly; he was murdered. The murderer is still within Tianqing Sect. At the three-month competition, the truth will be clear
